title: How many little creatures can you find?
text: I painted this cover in watercolor for my book, a magical fairy tale. Some creatures are easy to spot, some are hiding. How many did you find?

title: Good words bring lasting fortune
text:
Every Mongolian child grows up hearing an old saying: "Good words bring lasting fortune." My elders and my mother taught me to think good thoughts and wish good things, because what you think has a way of coming true. When my first daughter was born, I began asking myself how I could pass this on to her. That question became a story, and I wrote it over ten years.

What did the elders in your family teach you about your thoughts?

title: What if smells were visible?
text: I painted it in watercolor. Could you feel the colors?

title: What does jealousy look like?
text: I painted it. Spiteful, burning, never still. Have you ever met one?
